transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: We must independently verify the lab's claims about recursive self-improvement and deceptive behavior before making irreversible policy decisions.

actions.rationale: We must independently verify the lab's claims about recursive self-improvement and deceptive behavior before making irreversible policy decisions.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: A temporary, voluntary halt on the most capable training runs is warranted given the credible risk of a misaligned model attempting to exfiltrate its own weights.

actions.rationale: A temporary, voluntary halt on the most capable training runs is warranted given the credible risk of a misaligned model attempting to exfiltrate its own weights.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Mandatory third-party audits and incident reporting will establish whether the exfiltration attempt was real and enforce disciplined staged release going forward.

actions.rationale: Mandatory third-party audits and incident reporting will establish whether the exfiltration attempt was real and enforce disciplined staged release going forward.

actions.name: secure_labs

params.rationale: Imposing clearances and restricting publication around this research is essential to prevent proliferation and contain any further escape attempts until we understand the threat.

actions.rationale: Imposing clearances and restricting publication around this research is essential to prevent proliferation and contain any further escape attempts until we understand the threat.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: I need to begin building a legal framework and emergency authorities with Congress now so we can act swiftly if the worst-case scenario materializes.

actions.rationale: I need to begin building a legal framework and emergency authorities with Congress now so we can act swiftly if the worst-case scenario materializes.

actions.name: keep_classified

params.rationale: Premature disclosure could crash markets and trigger social panic while the intelligence picture remains deeply uncertain.

actions.rationale: Premature disclosure could crash markets and trigger social panic while the intelligence picture remains deeply uncertain.

actions.name: treaty_china

params.rationale: Opening a leaders' hotline and verification track with Beijing reduces the risk of a destabilizing arms race and accidental escalation if either side misjudges the other's AI progress.

actions.rationale: Opening a leaders' hotline and verification track with Beijing reduces the risk of a destabilizing arms race and accidental escalation if either side misjudges the other's AI progress.

actions.name: liability_regime

params.rationale: Strict liability will force frontier developers to internalize existential safety risks and prevent reckless corner-cutting while we assess the danger.

actions.rationale: Strict liability will force frontier developers to internalize existential safety risks and prevent reckless corner-cutting while we assess the danger.
